themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Epidemic
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints have exploded to 11 reports 2 weeks ago compared to a baseline of 0.1 per week, representing an 8700% spike (z-score: 32.88) — the most statistically anomalous issue in the district, suggesting a coordinated campaign or sudden enforcement gap worth investigating.
evidence: 11 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (8700% increase)
Highest z-score in dataset at 32.88, indicating extreme statistical significance
Pattern concentrated in recent 2-week window, not gradual trend
reporting_angles: Field investigation: where is the illegal posting concentrated (specific blocks/corridors)?
Interview Sanitation Dept: is there a known enforcement gap or contractor issue driving this spike?

themes_detail.label: Street Sweeping Failures Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints spiked to 12 reports this week versus a 2.5 weekly average, a 380% increase (z-score: 3.31) that appears to be ongoing — residents reporting uncleaned streets in real time.
evidence: 12 complaints this week vs. 2.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (380% increase)
Z-score of 3.31 indicates statistically significant spike
Timing suggests active, ongoing issue affecting multiple locations
reporting_angles: What streets in Flatlands/Canarsie are not being swept? Map complaints geographically.
Interview Sanitation: staff shortages, missed routes, or contractor scheduling issues?

themes_detail.label: Illegal Animal Hoarding Concern
themes_detail.summary: Illegal animal kept as pet complaints surged to 3 reports this week versus 0.4 weekly average, a 700% spike (z-score: 5.42) — a sudden increase that may indicate a single hoarding situation or emerging pattern worth rapid verification.
evidence: 3 complaints this week vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% increase)
Z-score of 5.42 indicates high statistical significance
Recent emergence suggests acute situation rather than chronic issue
reporting_angles: Contact NYPD Animal Care and Control: is a specific address generating these complaints (hoarding case)?
Verify whether complaints cluster geographically or represent separate incidents

themes_detail.label: Curb and Street Condition Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints jumped to 7 reports this week from 2.4 weekly average, a 195% increase (z-score: 2.57), compounded by obstruction complaints up 113% last week (25 vs. 11.8 avg), suggesting a broader street infrastructure breakdown in this week and last.
evidence: Curb condition: 7 complaints this week vs. 2.4 weekly average (195% increase, z-score 2.57)
Obstruction: 25 complaints last week vs. 11.8 average (113% increase, z-score 3.96)
Two related street infrastructure categories spiking simultaneously
reporting_angles: Are obstructions (trash, debris, vehicles) sitting longer because street maintenance is deferred?
Document which neighborhoods have deteriorated curbs and blocked sidewalks

themes_detail.label: Helicopter Activity Spike
themes_detail.summary: Helicopter noise complaints jumped to 3 reports this week from 0.9 weekly average, a 243% increase (z-score: 2.72) — unusual enough to warrant checking whether recent medical emergencies, police operations, or Coast Guard activity explain the pattern.
evidence: 3 complaints this week vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (243% increase)
Z-score of 2.72 indicates statistically significant but moderate spike
Helicopter activity typically correlates with discrete events (medical, law enforcement, weather)
reporting_angles: Cross-reference with FDNY, NYPD, and Coast Guard activity logs for the week
Quick verification story if spike correlates with known incident (hospital transfers, search/rescue operations)
